items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text input composed with Field (native textarea through Field.Control render). Optional autoSize grows with content via CSS field-sizing, with no JavaScript or keydown handling, so Korean IME composition is unaffected.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included.
